description: Defines the EmployeeMembership entity class for ORM mapping, including properties, relationships, and getter/setter methods within the OrangeHRM project. Represents membership details associated with an employee, including subscription info and dates.

classes.name: EmployeeMembership
classes.description: Represents an employee's membership record, including associated employee and membership details, subscription information, and relevant dates.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the membership record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the membership record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this membership.

methods.name: setMembership
methods.description: Associates a Membership entity with this record.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPaidBy
methods.description: Retrieves who paid for the subscription.

methods.name: setSubscriptionPaidBy
methods.description: Sets who paid for the subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCurrency
methods.description: Gets the currency of the subscription.

methods.name: setSubscriptionCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the subscription.

methods.name: setSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Retrieves the renewal date of the subscription.

methods.name: setSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Sets the renewal date of the subscription.
